documents.title: Synthetic concept and quantity recipes — demonstration only
documents.text:
NOT AN OFFICIAL STANDARD. Demonstration recipes:
Synthetic recipe 1: site_clearance: site_area m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 2: excavation: footprint * 0.30 m3; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 3: foundation_concrete: footprint * 0.12 m3; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 4: rcc: gross_floor_area * 0.22 m3; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 5: reinforcement: gross_floor_area * 32 kg; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 6: formwork: gross_floor_area * 2.2 m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 7: masonry: wall_volume m3; 
Synthetic recipe 8: waterproofing: roof_area m2; 
Synthetic recipe 9: doors: door_area m2; 
Synthetic recipe 10: windows: window_area m2; 
Synthetic recipe 11: plaster: wall_finish_area m2; 
Synthetic recipe 12: painting: wall_finish_area m2; 
Synthetic recipe 13: flooring: net_floor_area m2; 
Synthetic recipe 14: plumbing: gross_floor_area m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 15: drainage: 1 item; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 16: electrical: gross_floor_area m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 17: earthing: 1 item; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 18: fire_safety: gross_floor_area m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 19: accessibility: 1 item; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 20: external: site_area - footprint m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 21: testing: 1 item; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 22: site_facilities: duration_months month; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 23: hvac: gross_floor_area m2; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
Synthetic recipe 24: solar: 1 item; Illustrative allowance only; not an official engineering norm.
